items.hed: Texans: Stroud’s best camp day, then the Raiders on Thursday
items.insight: Club beat (John Harris, Sunday): C.J. Stroud and the offense had their best padded practice of camp — seven straight seven-on-seven completions and a deep ball to rookie Lewis Bond. Next public date is Thursday, Aug 20, 7 p.m. CT vs. Las Vegas at Reliant. Preseason. Watch the line and the ball, not the hype.

items.hed: Astros drop the Mariners series; Seattle owns the season series
items.insight: MLB: Saturday at Daikin Park, Seattle won 10–5 (Houston then 63-61). KPRC: Sunday Night Baseball, Mariners 3–2, Houston now 9–2 against Seattle this year. Next: Angels on Tuesday. The window is still open. The division math got harder overnight.
